options.label: F
options.text: The mapping represents y as a function of x, because each y-value corresponds to exactly one x-value.

options.label: G
options.text: The mapping does not represent y as a function of x, because two of the x-values correspond to the same y-value.

options.label: H
options.text: The mapping represents y as a function of x, because each x-value corresponds to exactly one y-value.

options.label: J
options.text: The mapping does not represent y as a function of x, because there are more x-values than different corresponding y-values.
